title: Korean Stir-Fried Potato Strips (Gamja-chae Bokkeum)
summary: A simple Korean side dish of thin potato strips stir-fried with carrot and onion until tender with a little bite.

steps.description: Peel the 2 potatoes and cut them into thin matchsticks about 2–3mm thick.
Soak the potato matchsticks in enough cold water to cover for about 5 minutes to remove surface starch. Rinse twice, drain thoroughly in a colander, and shake off excess water.
Cut the 1/4 onion and 1/4 carrot into matchsticks roughly the same thickness as the potatoes.
Heat 1 1/2 tbsp neutral cooking oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the potatoes and carrots and stir-fry for about 4 minutes, tossing regularly.
Add the onion and stir-fry for another 2–3 minutes, until the potato strips are slightly translucent and cooked through but still hold their shape. Cook for 1–2 minutes longer if needed.
Season with 1/3 tsp salt and a pinch of ground black pepper. Turn off the heat, toss with 1 tsp toasted sesame oil, and finish with 1 tsp toasted sesame seeds.
